scope: Bounded coding audit of existing public 2024–2026 source abstracts; not independent validation of a historical classifier.
recommendation: For automatic historical trends use multi-label, explicitly named method signals and label them as text coding. Do not present deterministic matches as independently verified designs or force a primary design.

input_policy.methods: Use original abstracts only. Do not use title or keywords to assert a method was actually used, and never use programme/author fields. Titles may be separately displayed as low-evidence signals if explicitly labelled.
input_policy.themes: Title + original abstract + author keywords, excluding programme/institution labels. Overlapping dictionary signals, not authoritative subject classifications.
input_policy.missing_abstract: No method signal is unknown, not no method used. Keep a missing/uncodable series and denominator. Do not use zero as known absence.
input_policy.languages: Finnish, English, Swedish; patterns are candidate lexicon, not a trained/validated classifier.
input_policy.normalization: NFKC, casefold, whitespace collapse; repair soft hyphens only, retain source text separately. Do not aggressively join ordinary hyphens.

context_rules: Require positive attachment to the present study: this thesis/study/research + is/uses/employs/combines/applies; tutkielma/tutkimus/opinnäyte + on/toteutettiin/lähestyn/käytän/hyödynnän/perustuu/kiinnittyi; avhandlingen/studien/jag + använder/tillämpar/utgår från/genomfördes. A nearby first-person research action can suffice.
The label and its self-study cue should be in the same sentence or a bounded local span (roughly 200 characters), not anywhere in the abstract. Finnish inflections must be allowed.
Exclude local explicit negatives: ei/emme/en + käytä/käytetty/ole; not/never/without; inte/ej/utan. Negation requires scope, not suppressing an entire sentence because it contains any negative word.

Exclude or mark weak future/proposal use: jatkotutkimuksessa/voisi/tulevaisuudessa; future research/could be used/propose using; framtida forskning/skulle kunna. A recommendation is not the study methodology.

Exclude background/cited research: aiempi/aikaisempi tutkimus/lähdekirjallisuus/taustoitus; previous research/literature/background; tidigare forskning. Theoretical framework + method-family term is not sufficient.

Flag partiality/combination: piirteitä/osalta/sivuaa/risteykseen/yhdistelee; features/aspects/part of/combines; inslag/delvis/kombinerar. Multiple explicit methods remain overlapping, not a fabricated single main design.
Preserve exact supporting sentence, source field and source URL for every visible signal. In trends disclose dictionary version and re-code all years uniformly, including 2024–2026.
Comparison with old manual annotations measures agreement, not truth; old annotation schema deliberately applies precedence and includes PDF evidence unavailable to abstract-only coding.

method_candidates.note: Explicit art-based action research. A compound occurrence must not produce a second generic artistic-research label automatically.
Require the author to attach this term to the present study or its actual approach; exclude background or a named publication.
Own-life writing, diary or first-person prose alone do not establish autoethnography. Partial features should not determine a primary design.
ABAR is a subtype, so a multi-label series needs explicit disclosure about overlap or should suppress the generic parent category.
One location, one participant group or a case example alone is insufficient.
Interview material is collection evidence only; do not automatically promote it to research design.
Exclude autoethnography lexical substring. A theory merely influenced by ethnography is weaker evidence.
Generic katsaus/overview/review of a subject is not a literature-review design. A background literature chapter is also insufficient.
Questionnaires are a collection technique unless the source identifies the design as a survey.
May be analysis rather than whole design; show as a method signal unless explicit design is given. The word discourse alone is not enough.
Narratives or biographies as the topic are not automatically the research method; narrative analysis belongs to analysis.
Developing a teaching exercise or making a design artefact alone does not establish the named research design.
Require explicit self-methodological attachment: tutkimusote/lähestymistapa/menetelmä, approach/methodology, ansats/metod. Fenomenografia is a different family, not this code.
Finnish monimenetelmällinen only means multiple methods; do not assume a qualitative+quantitative mixed-method design.
A broad explicit qualitative signal is defensible, but not a reason to erase the named subdesign. Phenomenography deserves its own displayed signal even if this controlled parent groups it.
Every thesis has a theoretical framework. Framework/theory citations alone are not the design.

theme_candidates.caution: Do not match programme label kuvataidekasvatus/art education alone.
Generic environment/ympäristö can mean a classroom; prefer ecological context.
Finnish aineisto/material as research data is not materiality; never match generic material alone.
Care word requires topic context, not take care of practical arrangements.
Do not infer an author identity or profession from name or simply being a student.
Participant/osallistuja alone is not participation/delaktighet as a theme.
Do not match generic art/taide or every work in art education.
Photography alone is not necessarily digital culture.
Lapin/Lappland or Aalto in institution metadata is not itself a theme; use title/abstract/keywords only.
Generic visual or image alone is too broad.
Studying a class is not automatically a community theme.
Every abstract contains research/tutkimus; do not match those generic terms.

coverage_expected.reason: No historical source corpus or completed classifier was available for this bounded audit. Estimating accuracy/coverage numerically would invent evidence. Explicit named families are retrievable, but conservative context gating will intentionally leave many abstracts unclassified.
main_biases: Earlier years can have shorter or missing abstracts; apparent growth can be metadata growth.
Methodological terminology changes over time and translation can change matching.
A dictionary covers selected named families; absent matches do not imply absent methods or themes.
Historical themes should be presented as text signals with all-record and usable-text denominators.
Use within-university percentages; combined thesis-weighted share and equal-university mean are different metrics.
A partially harvested year cannot be treated as complete output or a zero-production year.
